title: cyclamen hederifolium subsp. balearicum
intro: Cyclamen hederifolium subsp. balearicum, commonly known as the Balearic cyclamen, is a subspecies of flowering perennial plant native to the Balearic Islands in the Mediterranean. It belongs to the family Primulaceae and is valued for its medicinal properties. The Balearic cyclamen is known to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-hemorrhagic, and anti- spasmodic effects.
